exposure: Time interval from bariatric surgery to pregnancy (<12 months vs ≥12 months)
Type of bariatric surgery (restrictive vs combined restrictive-malabsorptive)
pregnancy within 12 months after bariatric surgery
pregnancy at or after 12 months after bariatric surgery
cohort: 76 women with singleton live births after bariatric surgery
finding: Pregnancy <12 months after bariatric surgery was associated with lower gestational weight gain, higher frequency of weight loss during pregnancy, and less postpartum weight retention at 6 months compared to pregnancy ≥12 months after surgery.
birth_weight: Birth weight data collected, but no differences found between groups.
